import ast


def run_code_snippet(user_code: str):
    if not isinstance(user_code, str):
        raise ValueError("user_code must be a string")

    try:
        parsed = ast.parse(user_code, mode="exec")
    except SyntaxError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid syntax: {exc}") from exc

    allowed_nodes = (
        ast.Module,
        ast.Assign,
        ast.AugAssign,
        ast.Expr,
        ast.BinOp,
        ast.UnaryOp,
        ast.BoolOp,
        ast.Compare,
        ast.Constant,
        ast.Name,
        ast.Load,
        ast.Store,
        ast.Add,
        ast.Sub,
        ast.Mult,
        ast.Div,
        ast.FloorDiv,
        ast.Mod,
        ast.Pow,
        ast.USub,
        ast.UAdd,
        ast.Not,
        ast.And,
        ast.Or,
        ast.Eq,
        ast.NotEq,
        ast.Lt,
        ast.LtE,
        ast.Gt,
        ast.GtE,
        ast.Is,
        ast.IsNot,
        ast.In,
        ast.NotIn,
    )

    for node in ast.walk(parsed):
        if not isinstance(node, allowed_nodes):
            raise ValueError(f"Prohibited operation: {type(node).__name__}")
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            name = node.id
            if name.startswith("__") and name.endswith("__"):
                raise ValueError(f"Prohibited name: {name}")
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
            if not isinstance(node.value, (int, float, str, bool, type(None))):
                raise ValueError(f"Prohibited constant type: {type(node.value).__name__}")

    namespace = {"__builtins__": {}}

    try:
        compiled = compile(parsed, "<user_code>", "exec")
        exec(compiled, namespace, namespace)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Execution error: {exc}") from exc

    result = None
    if parsed.body and isinstance(parsed.body[-1], ast.Expr):
        last_expr = parsed.body[-1]
        try:
            expr_obj = ast.Expression(body=last_expr.value)
            ast.fix_missing_locations(expr_obj)
            compiled_expr = compile(expr_obj, "<user_code>", "eval")
            result = eval(compiled_expr, namespace, namespace)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ValueError(f"Execution error: {exc}") from exc

    return result
